topic: Sensor model deployment strategy for Germany
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on deploying a new sensor model for a client in Germany. Initial discrepancies were noted regarding the number of sensors (client reported 65 new and 25 old; internal records showed 104). After reviewing facility and box data, it was confirmed that the discrepancy was due to several moved facilities and one broken box.

The main decision point concerned how to deploy the new sensor model. The client's request was to install the new model on the 65 new sensors while keeping the old model on the 25 existing ones, noting an overlap in categories. It was determined that creating separate categories for either the new or old sensors would not break other jobs or processes, as clients cannot select a category via filters.

The deployment plan is approved to proceed with this separation.
decisions: The new sensor model will be deployed on the 65 new sensors and the old model retained on the 25 existing sensors.
action_items: Someone should ask Tim from Operations to update the system/process based on the agreed category separation.
